note: Chevrolet Express 2500/3500 cargo van (gas engines) as GM prints it in '2023 Express Van - Cargo' (GM Upfitter, Special Service specification guide, 25 pages), page 18 'SPECIFICATIONS - GAS ENGINE', figures printed as in./mm. Read twice on 2026-11-22: poppler pdftotext -layout and pdftotext -raw of the PDF, identical. 2500 and 3500 print the same dimensions for the same wheelbase, so there is one body per wheelbase. Planner preset (conservative): length = load floor length to the front seat, width = inside width between the wheelhousings over the whole length, height = cargo area height, door = rear door opening width at beltline x rear door opening height; each figure uses the smaller of in x 25.4 and the printed mm. Payload differs by engine and series, so the preset has none. No prices.
